prompts.title: Generate CSC KPI for Work Effort
prompts.description: As a Project Manager, review the Desired Outcome(s) and Project Objective(s) to generate CSC, KPI, KPI Value Type, and KPI Target Date for the work effort. Use this prompt to structure measurable items that can be tracked throughout the project lifecycle.
prompts.author: Rathinam, Archana [TECH]

prompts.title: Review CSC KPI and Refine Project Description for Projects
prompts.description: CSC is Critical Success Criteria; this prompt helps validate that measurable terms of what must be done for the work effort to be considered successful are clearly defined and aligned with project objectives.
prompts.author: Rathinam, Archana [TECH]
